approved_scope.title: Synchronize change summary state after verification
approved_scope.description: Synchronize change summary state after verification
acceptance_criteria: A pre-verification refusal preserves the prior lifecycle state, and a failed publication leaves the previous state and evidence together.
After change check records either a passing verification or a completed failing verification, state.json, change.md, and change status all report verifying.
Rechecking an active change whose summary still says implementing repairs its summary and keeps its Markdown notes.
change check --commit records the synchronized summary and leaves passing evidence usable for review.

answers.constraints: A refusal is a result worth recording (#847). Use confined durable project writes and keep the completed attempt and its projections together.
